caption: The drawing depicts a circular arrangement of sculptural scenes and objects, all rendered in shades of brown, gold, and tan. The ring is composed of a series of interconnected cup-shaped bases, each supporting a group of human figures in various dynamic postures. At the top center, a single standing male figure holds a staff, flanked by two decorative vertical elements that curve outward and downward. Moving clockwise, there is a pair of figures, one standing and the other seated, on a cup adorned with scrollwork; the next segment shows a standing figure reaching forward with arms outstretched. The composition continues with a figure standing on an abstract wave-like base, followed by a group of two figures: one kneeling and the other reaching downwards. Further along, a cup supports an arrangement with three figures, one kneeling and two interacting. At the bottom center of the ring, below the main circle, there is a domed object with a cross atop it, supported by four animal-like legs, sitting on a stepped base marked "1838." Additional decorative elements, including shells and vegetal motifs, are clustered beneath the central dome. On the left side of the ring, more groups of figures interact, with one pair engaged in an action involving a draped object, and a single figure standing on another wave-like form. The entire composition is rendered with shading and detailing to give a three-dimensional effect, with the background left plain and uncolored.
title: Cycle of Life Carving
